token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Answer one explicitly selected quick factual question about the existing Dell case. Plan relevant reads and correct tool errors; do not rewrite the report or restart research.
token_budget_basis.input_scale: Compact ten-paper catalog (about 10k characters), the actual question and public conversation text without nested citation payloads. Full current report, relevant claims, SQL facts and original sources are available on demand; no other agent private messages.
required_outputs: Concise Chinese answer with exact current paper:claim citations
Correct company, period, unit, provenance and uncertainty; no report mutation
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: Existing native read-only MCP tools and one cited-answer submission; no full report or review JSON. Allow local error feedback and multiple reads.
token_budget_basis.materiality_quality_risk: S2 preferred for financial facts; old paper/source binding alone does not prove interpretation. No hidden downgrade of complex analysis: UI keeps deep Pro mode. Review simple answer against real sources before claiming qualification.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: Default capacity is based on development workloads, not a cost or quality guarantee. Record task-specific input scale, required output and measured usage before increasing limits.
